notes.title: "A Weekend in Puzzleburg" free content update 2 "So Hot" bug fix
notes.content:
I have just pushed a new build for the cozy RPG [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/url] that has minor bug fixes for the game's [u]free content update[/u] number 2 [b]"So Hot"[/b] that recently released.

With these minor bug fixes in place, I have also kicked off a visibility round to bring additional awareness to the game and the latest new free content update.  Which is to say - if you've already played the new content detailed below and you're seeing this message because of the increased reach of the visibility round, this new build doesn't introduce anything additional.  But if you've yet to play [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] since the new content drop, this is your travel agent telling you [b]it's a wonderful time for a return trip to Puzzleburg - or a first visit if you've never been![/b]

Here is a refresher on what's new in the [u]free content update[/u] [b]"So Hot"[/b]:

This adds two additional quests to the game:

1. [b]So Hot (side quest):[/b] If you can find some sunscreen for one of the beachgoers, you'll be treated to a brief man-on-the-street-type interview.  This interview goes in different directions depending on what job class you've chosen!  I've always wanted to do a bit more with the job class, and this gives even more reason to make repeat visits to Puzzleburg so you can try out different job classes and get new experiences

2. [b]Quite a Pickle (side quest):[/b] Someone in town has a jar of pickles they can't open. Can you find some way to get it open?  You might even find a new technique that helps you in real life (but no guarantees!)

And of course, Dante the hotel concierge has hints for each stage of these new quests.  Just like every quest in the game, he always has a hint at the ready so you never get stuck!

The two side quests have been added to the [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/everything-you-can-do-and-see-in-puzzleburg]Everything You Can See and Do in Puzzleburg[/url] guide so that you know exactly how to trigger [u]every[/u] quest in the game.

I have also added a [b]new trailer[/b] to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]store page[/url].  This new trailer doesn't show new content from the So Hot update, but it does better reflect the wide range of activities in available in Puzzleburg.  I've always felt that I could put together a better trailer for the game, so I've used this free content update as an excuse to do just that!

Whether this will be your first trip to Puzzleburg or an enticement to go back for a return trip, I hope you enjoy the new things to do in town now that the [b]free [u]So Hot[/u] content update[/b] has arrived.

The cozy RPG [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] is available for purchase on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg[/url]

notes.title: Free content update "So Hot" coming to Puzzleburg February 2025
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce that the cozy RPG [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] (Steam page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]here[/url]) will be getting a [b]free content update[/b] called [b]So Hot[/b] releasing [b]February 2025[/b] for the game's 2-year anniversary.

When I launched [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] back on February 17, 2023 (nearly two years ago at this point), there were a few ideas I really liked but were too complex to get into the game by its launch date.  So I held onto those ideas and kept plugging away on them post-launch.  For the game's one-year anniversary in February 2024, I added these [b]three quests[/b]:

[olist]
[*] [b]Billie the Kid[/b] (side quest)
[*] [b]The One Yo-Yo[/b] (side quest)
[*] [b]Do Not Disturb[/b] (main quest)
[/olist]

For the game's 2-year anniversary, I'm adding [b]another two quests[/b]:
[olist]
[*] [b]So Hot[/b] (side quest): this is a simple-on-the-surface quest to get some sunscreen for someone in Puzzleburg. If you complete this quest, you are then interviewed by the recipient for their social media feed, with the interview branching based on your chosen profession!  Feedback from players on the job class selection has been positive, but I've always personally wanted to do a bit more with it, and this quest leverages your chosen profession to further customize your weekend in Puzzleburg
[*] [b]Quite a Pickle[/b] (side quest): A Puzzleburg citizen has a jar of pickles that just won't open.  See if you can figure out who has a technique to get it open, and maybe you'll even pick up a new skill you can use in your own life!
[/olist]

The two side quests will be added to the [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/everything-you-can-do-and-see-in-puzzleburg]Everything You Can See and Do in Puzzleburg[/url] guide when the free content update goes live so that you know exactly how to trigger each one.

And of course, [b]Dante the hotel concierge has hints for each stage of these new quests[/b].  Just like all the quests in the game, he always has a hint at the ready so you never get stuck!

Whether this will be your first trip to Puzzleburg or an enticement to go back for a return trip, I hope you enjoy the new things to do in town when the [b]free[/b] content update [b]So Hot[/b] arrives [b]February 2025[/b].

notes.title: The free content update "This Town Ain't Big Enough" expands Puzzleburg
notes.content:
The town of Puzzleburg has just gotten bigger!  The [b]free[/b] content update [b]This Town Ain't Big Enough[/b] is [b]out now[/b] and expands [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]Steam page here[/url]) with new characters, new quests, and new items.

Here are the three quests now added to [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i]:

1. [b]Billie the Kid (side quest):[/b] this is an Old West-themed game of hide-and-seek that puts your knowledge of the town to the test as you try to find a kid who goes by Billie the Bandit hiding in different spots all around Puzzleburg (if you can catch her four times, she declares "I knew this town wasn't big enough!")
2. [b]The One Yo-Yo (side quest):[/b] here you may very well determine the entire future of Puzzleburg!  Two girls in town each seek a yo-yo that is prophesied to belong to the future mayor of Puzzleburg.  It falls to you as the "yo-yo bearer" to decide which candidate should receive the legendary object and become anointed as the chosen one who will someday rule the land (or you can hold onto it for yourself, of course)
3. [b]Do Not Disturb (main quest):[/b] at a random point in the game, your hotel room key will malfunction, prohibiting you from entering your own hotel room.  But rest assured, a simple trip to the hotel front desk will resolve the situation.  Just a bit of flavor here to better capture the vacation slice-of-life.  And note that you will only ever get locked out of your hotel room a single time no matter how many times you use the room key (this quest occurs at random when trying to access your room, and only after a certain point in the game after you've gotten used to entering and exiting your room freely, for maximum effect)

And of course, [b]Dante the hotel concierge has hints for each stage of these new quests[/b].  Just like all the quests in the original release, he always has a hint at the ready so you never get stuck!

The two side quests are also added to the [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/everything-you-can-do-and-see-in-puzzleburg]Everything You Can See and Do in Puzzleburg[/url] guide so you know exactly how to trigger each one (the new main quest is triggered automatically and at random, so there's nothing special you need to do to trigger it).

Whether this will be your first trip to Puzzleburg or an enticement to go back for a return trip, I hope you enjoy the new things to do in town with the [b]free[/b] content update [b]This Town Ain't Big Enough[/b] that is [b]available now[/b].

And if you've played the game but haven't already left a review, [b]please consider leaving a review for the game on Steam[/b].  After being out for a year, the game still only has [b]two[/b] reviews.  With [b]ten[/b] reviews, the game would receive a rating (positive, mostly positive, mixed, mostly negative, or negative).  [b]I would like to reach the ten review mark, so please consider leaving a review[/b] - it doesn't matter whether your review is positive or negative, simply sharing your perspective will let others know what to expect with this indie game.  You can leave a review directly from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]the game's Steam store page[/url] if you already own a copy of the game.  It's that easy.

[i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] is available for purchase on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg[/url]

notes.title: A look back at 2023 and a look ahead to 2024
notes.content:
With it now being December, I figure this would be a good time to look back at the year 2023 for what I accomplished with Sunny Demeanor Games and pull back the curtain a bit on what's to come in 2024.

2023:
[list]
[*] Released my first video game [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] on February 17, 2023 - you can purchase it on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg[/url]
[*] Received my first review for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] (LadiesGamers.com gave it a rating of "I Like It" [url=https://ladiesgamers.com/a-weekend-in-puzzleburg-review]here[/url])
[*] [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] was featured in the Kotaku article [url=https://kotaku.com/steam-pc-best-indie-games-demo-youtube-trailer-1850485229]Ten New Games on Steam Bursting with Imagination[/url]
[*] Published a demo for my next video game, the interactive spy novel [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i], which is a spin-off from [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] based on one of the hotel room TV channels
[*] [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] participated in the October Steam Next Fest
[*] I ran my first-ever Kickstarter (for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i]).  The Kickstarter unfortunately didn't get funded, but the game will still be completed and released in March 2024 (albeit without having a James Bond-esque theme song like I envisioned)
[/list]

2024:
[list]
[*] I am hereby announcing a free content update for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] called the [b]"This Town Ain't Big Enough" update[/b] coming in the [b]first half of 2024[/b]. This will add [b]three new quests[/b] to the game, including one quest where you play an Old West-themed game of hide-and-seek trying to find a kid in different spots all over town and another quest that may very well dictate the future of Puzzleburg itself!
[*] [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] will release in March 2024 - you can wishlist it and play the free demo on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight[/url]
[*] I am also in pre-production on my next game, which will be a second entry in the [i][b]There's Always a Madman series[/b][/i].  I expect that game to release in Q1 2025
[/list]

So there you have it - everything going on in the world of Sunny Demeanor Games as we wrap up 2023 and head into 2024 (and even a sneak peek at something on the agenda for 2025).

Please remember that [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] is already for sale on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]here[/url].  You can also wishlist and play the free demo for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]here[/url].

notes.title: Kickstarter launches Oct 9 for spin-off game "There's Always a Madman"
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you've enjoyed your weekend vacation in Puzzleburg!  I'm happy to announce that my next game is a spin-off of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg][i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i][/url].

This new game is a comedic spy thriller interactive novel called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight][i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i][/url] and has a [b]Kickstarter campaign launching Monday October 9th, 2023 at 1pm US Eastern time[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Wishlist and play the free demo[/b] for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] right now right here (the game is even part of the October 2023 Steam Next Fest): [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight[/url].  The free demo contains 5 of the 11 chapters from the full game
[*] [b]Sign up right here to be notified when the Kickstarter campaign goes live[/b] on Monday October 9th at 1pm US Eastern time: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sunnydemeanorgames/theres-always-a-madman-fight-or-flight]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sunnydemeanorgames/theres-always-a-madman-fight-or-flight[/url]
[*] [b]Preview the Kickstarter rewards tiers[/b] in this company blog post: [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/what-rewards-will-be-available-in-the-theres-always-a-madman-kickstarter-launching-oct-9-2023]What rewards will be available in the "There's Always a Madman" Kickstarter launching Oct 9, 2023?[/url].  A copy of the game costs <$10, but you can obtain early bird discounts, get your name in the credits, play the game up to 2 weeks before the release date, or even get a character in the game named after YOU
[/list]

[h2]About There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/h2]

Step into the shoes of the suave secret agent Franklin Benjamin in this single-player spy thriller interactive novel.  Drive fast cars, charm beautiful women, and do whatever it takes to save the world from a madman against impossible odds.  [b]Because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b]

For full details on the game, please check out the game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]Steam page[/url] or the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sunnydemeanorgames/theres-always-a-madman-fight-or-flight]Kickstarter campaign[/url] once it goes live.

[h2]How is [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] connected to [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i]?[/h2]

The character of fictional secret agent Franklin Benjamin first originated in [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] where you can view a few scenes from his spy film "Always Say Always" on the hotel room TV's channel 10.  There are a few other instances where he comes up in the game, including the actor's biography and the "Always Say Always" in-game video game item that you can acquire.  [b]I like to think that [i]There's Always a Madman[/i] is representative of how the "Always Say Always" video game item in [i]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/i] would play[/b]

For further details on the connection between these two games, please refer to this company blog post: [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/is-there-any-connection-between-a-weekend-in-puzzleburg-and-theres-always-a-madman]Is there any connection between A Weekend in Puzzleburg and There's Always a Madman?[/url].

[h2]Does this mean that development for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] has ended?[/h2]

Not necessarily!  I'm planning a free content update for the game at some yet-to-be-determined point.



Lastly - for member of the press and streamers, the press kit for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] can be found [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JEw_r99uzERAWqJIU2tOwzl3AKQdPc_O]here[/url].  And the press kit for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] can be found [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lnIXeWPtdt628D7_A7sxhh8PzSJsM4B2]here[/url].

notes.title: A Weekend in Puzzleburg has gone gold + soundtrack DLC + deluxe edition
notes.content:
I am thrilled to announce that [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] has passed Valve's certification checks and can be considered to have "[b]gone gold[/b]" roughly two months ahead of its release on Friday February 17, 2023 (for reference, "going gold" generally means when a game starts being physically printed onto discs, which typically happens about a month before the release date.  [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] will be a digital-only release, so I am considering the point at which the storefront approves a build of the game to be my "going gold" point).

In addition, the game's title track (released in two versions - one with vocals and one as an instrumental version) will go on sale the same day as the game - Friday, February 17, 2023.   You can wishlist the soundtrack on this page which just launched: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179140/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg_Soundtrack

There will also be a [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] where you can pick up the [b]game and the soundtrack[/b] together.  Please note that the soundtrack is limited to the two tracks mentioned above - the game of course has many more tracks than that, but those are the only two I have the ability to sell due to licensing agreements for the other tracks.

If you do not want to wait for release day to begin listening to the music from [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] (or you simply prefer to have your music outside of Steam), you can purchase the game's soundtrack on [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BBMG8L78/ref=sr_1_3?crid=20R0RROPEUWAB&keywords=a+weekend+in+puzzleburg&qid=1671653964&sprefix=%2Caps%2C268&sr=8-3]Amazon[/url] and [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/i-spent-a-weekend-in-puzzleburg-a-weekend/1641280273]Apple Music[/url] right now.


[h3]So what are you working on for the next two months if the game has already gone gold?[/h3]

Although a build of the game has been approved, there are still plenty of things left to do, including but not limited to:
[list]
[*] Enhancing existing art and character dialog
[*] Putting in additional content, such as new side quests
[*] Playtesting the game
[*] Fixing bugs identified through playtesting
[/list]
I hope you pick up A Weekend in Puzzleburg - either the base version or the Deluxe Edition - when the game releases on Friday February 17, 2023. In the meantime, please wishlist and try out the free demo on Steam here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg

notes.title: Price + Launch Discount Announced
notes.content:
[i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] [b]will cost $18 at launch[/b] ($20 normal price with a 10% launch discount to reward early players).  I would like to emphasize that with [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i], [b]you're not buying a video game so much as you're buying an entire vacation[/b].  One that you can play over and over again whenever you want, getting new experiences each time.  All that for under $20.

To arrive at this price, I examined similar games available on Steam both in terms of their price (non-sale price, rounded to the nearest dollar for simplicity) and length (completionist play length taken from howlongtobeat.com, rounded to the nearest hour for simplicity), arranged from cheapest to most expensive, and then compared against [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i].  Here are the reference games, along with the same info for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i]:

[list]
[*] [i]A Short Hike[/i]; 5 hours; $8 price
[*] [i]To the Moon[/i]; 5 hours; $10 price
[*] [i]Stardew Valley[/i]; 153 hours; $15 price
[*] [i]Unpacking[/i]; 5 hours; $20 price
[*] [i]Wayward Strand[/i]; 6 hours; $20 price
[*] [i]TOEM[/i]; 6 hours; $20 price
[*] [i]Life is Strange[/i]; 19 hours; $20 price ($40 for Remastered Collection containing the first game and Before the Storm, so $20 each)
[*] [i]Eastshade[/i]; 14 hours; $25 price
[*] [i]Bugsnax[/i]; 14 hours; $25 price
[/list]
[list]
[*] [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i]; 10 hours (it's 4 hours for a single playthrough, so I'd consider 3 playthroughs for 10 hours as a rough time estimate for a completionist to experience the different books and character builds in the game, and assuming the first playthrough takes longer than subsequent playthroughs); $20 price
[/list]

In general, similar games available on Steam range from $8-$25, with [i]A Short Hike[/i] and [i]To the Moon[/i] on the low end ($8 and $10, respectively) and [i]Bugsnax[/i] and [i]Eastshade[/i] on the high end ($25 each).  As such, I feel comfortable setting the price for [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] at $20, putting the game at the same price as [i]Unpacking[/i], [i]Wayward Strand[/i], [i]TOEM[/i], and [i]Life is Strange[/i].   In addition, [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] supports multiple playthroughs through the use of different character builds and different books to read, whereas these other games are largely one and done experiences.

[h3]Will there be regional pricing?[/h3]
Yes, [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] will receive regional pricing via Valve's recommended regional prices.  In most cases, this results in the price being lower than it would normally be if the price was calculated based off of current exchange rates.  I do not pretend to be an expert in buying power for each country across the globe, so I will instead rely on Valve's expertise here.

So there you have it.  I hope you pick up [i][b]A Weekend in Puzzleburg[/b][/i] for [b]$17.99[/b] (or whatever you're regionally-adjusted launch discount price is) when [b]the game releases on February 17, 2023[/b].  In the meantime, please wishlist and try out the free demo on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1929760/A_Weekend_in_Puzzleburg[/url]

Further details can be found on the company's weekly blog post regarding the launch price announcement here: [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/how-much-will-a-weekend-in-puzzleburg-cost]https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news/articles/how-much-will-a-weekend-in-puzzleburg-cost[/url]

notes.title: Now you can take your own selfies in "A Weekend in Puzzleburg"
notes.content:
One of the big pieces of feedback I've received on the demo is a desire to actually be able to take your own selfie at the point in the game when Cindy (the main character) takes a selfie of the "welcome to Puzzleburg" sign.  As such, I've released a new version of the demo that allows you to do just that. 

Here are the new features in demo version 1.1.1:
1. The game now works with the Steam overlay through the typical Shift + Tab command.  In addition, [b]this means you can take screenshots any time you want like with any other Steam game by pressing F12[/b] (or Function + F12, which is what works on my PC).  So when Cindy takes a selfie at the welcome sign, you too can grab a screenshot of your own if you like.  [b]Screenshots are accessible in the Steam app by going to View -> Screenshots[/b]
2. There is improved waypathing in certain areas, in particular the arcade has been slightly redesigned so you can cut through the middle
3. Bug fixes, in particular for the save screen where the number of quests completed wasn't displaying the correct number

For further updates about A Weekend in Puzzleburg, please refer to the [url=https://sunnydemeanorgames.com/news]weekly blog[/url] on the company website.
